description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Collective Agreement No. 28 of 2015 entered into between Housing Development Finance Corporation Bank of Sri Lanka and The Ceylon Bank Employees'Union - Collective Agreement No. 26 of 2015 entered into between The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited and The Ceylon Bank Employees' Union
reasoning: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between a bank and a union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, salary structures, allowances, and working conditions. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks governing employment relations, specifically published in accordance with statutory authority (Section 06 of the Industrial Disputes Act).
